entry: V2.21 defaults with only post-arrow body-clear confirmation varied: 0, 1 or 2 completed 15m closes. Entry at max(arrow, touch, arrow+post) close, Tue-Fri NY.
exit: First profitable 15m 2/2 pivot after entry, market fill at confirmation close; native initial stop first. No end-of-day exit; residual positions marked at study end separately.
stops: Matched touch candle extreme plus 0.2% of entry, rounded outward to tick (V2.21 original).
controls: Per variant: one deterministic random entry per signal without replacement, same symbol, side, UTC week, chronological half and ATR14/close bucket; Tue-Fri NY close; real arrows/entries excluded; same relative risk, exit and fees.
limitations: Idealized zero-latency close fills on 5m OHLC, no funding/spread/depth. R is independent original-risk return. One known year, no parameter search beyond the three Pine options.
